purpose: Fixed development gate for the already frozen public upstream result MAT promotion lane; it is not a parameter-selection rule.

fixed_gate.interpretation: A fixed <1.8 m aggregate mean is the goal-aligned top-solution-scale screen; it is evaluated after scoring and cannot select between the predeclared GNSS and GNSS+IMU lanes.
fixed_gate.per_route_non_regression: Every declared route must have exact matching keys, full truth coverage, finite diagnostics, and no continuity violation.
fixed_gate.vertical_metric: not available in the official ground_truth.csv/scoring contract; upstream MAT height is reported only as a finite conversion check.
fixed_gate.promotion: Only a passing fixed gate may justify later truth-free test conversion; validation and holdout remain sealed in this record.

comparison.selection: none; both lanes are scored and retained in the report regardless of relative score
